purpose: Graded ayat for the diagnostic. use=assess: test items — ayat most readers have not memorized (the longer surahs of Juz' Amma and medium surahs), with difficulty 1 (easy) to 3 (hard) from length and the number of Tajweed rules. use=warmup: famous short surahs, used only to check memorization, never as test items. An ayah is used only when text_ar, verified_by and verified_on are all filled in (Sara checks it by hand against the Madinah Mushaf, as for data/quran_fatiha.json).
how_to_verify: Compare text_ar with the Mushaf word by word; check tajweed_words (word positions counted from 1, among words): madd, ghunnah and qalqalah are candidates found by rule on the marks, plain = words without madd used as wrong answers in «أين المد؟». Correct any list, then fill verified_by and verified_on (YYYY-MM-DD). rules: Tajweed rules on marked places (noon sakinah/tanween: izhar, idgham_ghunnah, idgham_no_ghunnah, iqlab, ikhfa; meem sakinah: izhar_shafawi, idgham_shafawi, ikhfa_shafawi; lam: shamsiyah, qamariyah), found by rule on the Uthmani marks — used in the rules questions once the ayah is verified.
source: مصحف المدينة النبوية — مجمع الملك فهد لطباعة المصحف الشريف (رواية حفص عن عاصم)
